verses.1: Praise my soul to the LORD, Jehovah, my God! You have been exalted above all other gods. Praise and honor be to you!
verses.2: The light of the sun is like a rainbow that spreads across the sky.
verses.3: The creature that lives in the water, with its thick skin, walks on wings made of air.
verses.4: He makes his servants into spirits who serve him; fire that burns.
verses.5: He established the earth on its proper foundations, forever and ever.
verses.6: The sun will be like a lamp, shining upon the mountains. The seas will stand still.
verses.7: From your anger, they will be freed; from the sound of your voice, they will be rescued.
verses.8: They will climb the mountains, descend into the valleys, and settle in this place. You have established them there.
verses.9: The boundaries of Samtah are beyond those of Yayavorun and Yishuvun; they serve to enclose the land.
verses.10: The ruler leads the people along the streams between the mountains.
verses.11: May all his days be filled with suffering; may his crops be destroyed and his plants wither away.
verses.12: Above them, in the heavens, they will be placed among the clouds. They will give forth their voices.
verses.13: May the mountains be filled with your fruits from your works; may the earth rejoice.
verses.14: They plant fields of grass for the use of cattle, and plants for human purposes, so that they can obtain bread from the earth.
verses.15: And the human heart shall rejoice, to see its faces shine from the smoke; and bread shall fill the human heart.
verses.16: May the trees of Jehovah be blessed, those that are planted in Lebanon.
verses.17: There, birds will provide us with protection and safety in their homes.
verses.18: The high mountains provide rocks that can be used as shelter for the sheep.
verses.19: He created a bird that knew when to fly.
verses.20: It became dark, and in that darkness, all living things in the forest died.
verses.21: The wicked cry out for help and seek refuge in God’s hands.
verses.22: When the sun rises, they will be gathered together; and to their destinies they will be brought.
verses.23: Man goes out to work and to serve until evening.
verses.24: How many wonderful things you have done, O LORD! You have created everything with great wisdom. The earth is full of your creations.
verses.25: That’s a vast and wide ocean. There are countless tiny creatures living there, along with those that are larger in size.
verses.26: There, they will walk towards that place where you created them to play.
verses.27: They all will be fulfilled, so that they can eat at that time.
verses.28: Give them them; let them open their hands. May they be blessed.
verses.29: Your faces will be hidden from sight; their hearts will be filled with fear. They will return to their dust.
verses.30: “Send your breath, and it will bring forth crops; and you will renew the face of the land.”
verses.31: May the glory of the LORD be forever; may the LORD rejoice in His works.
verses.32: He looked down at the earth, and it trembled. He stepped onto the mountains, and they became our home.
verses.33: I will sing to the LORD with all my heart, and I will praise the LORD before my enemies.
verses.34: My vines will cover it; I will rejoice in Him.
verses.35: The sins of the people will be removed from the earth. But the wicked still won’t be blessed by Jehovah.
